598:t_1:86.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(I'm counting on you to look after Princess $$ミネバ$$, $$バナージ$$...)

598:t_1:87.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(We'll be there soon, too. Let's make sure we live to meet again.)

598:t_1:88.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The $$プトレマイオス２$$... has gone on ahead.」

598:t_1:89.en:
$$レイアム$$
「They'll cover as much distance as they can with $$トランザム$$, then send out the $$ユニコーン$$...」

598:t_1:90.en:
$$オットー$$
「We're effectively using all of $c as a decoy. It will succeed without fail.」

598:t_1:92.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$... We recovered the $$クシャトリヤ$$, but...」

598:t_1:93.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Let $c use it. That's what she'd want, too.」

598:t_1:95.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm grateful, Captain $$オットー$$, that you let me aboard this ship.」

598:t_1:96.en:
$$オットー$$
「Don't mention it. You have a right to witness how this ends, too, Captain.」

598:t_1:97.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$インダストリアル７$$... Everything will be settled there...」

598:t_1:98.en:
$$オットー$$
「It was where everything began, too... Come to think of it, that's how long I've known you, Captain.」

598:t_1:99.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I never imagined I'd see the end of it from the bridge of this ship.」

598:t_1:101.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I think none of this would have happened if someone other than $$バナージ$$ had piloted the $$ユニコーン$$.」

598:t_1:103.en:
$$オットー$$
「And now, they're trying to fulfill their mission to bring it all to an end.」

598:t_1:104.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(I'm counting on you to look after Princess $$ミネバ$$, $$バナージ$$... You are the very future $$マリーダ$$ entrusted to us.)

598:t_1:105.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(We'll be there soon, too. Let's make sure we live to meet again.)

598:t_2:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...I've come back here again...」

598:t_2:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I've come back with you, just as I did then.」

598:t_2:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So much has happened since then...」

598:t_2:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「All those days of fighting over the Box... But let's end it today.」

598:t_2:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Too many people have died... If $$ラプラスの箱$$ isn't worth those sacrifices...」

598:t_2:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Whatever it is... whatever happens now... Promise me you'll come back to me...」

598:t_2:13.en:
???
「...I have been waiting... to tell you just one thing...」

598:t_2:14.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That voice... Who could it be...?」

598:t_2:15.en:
???
「A descendant of my family and the princess of $$ジオン$$... I could ask for no better people to entrust $$ラプラスの箱$$ to...」

598:t_2:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you someone from the $$ビスト財団$$...?」

598:t_2:17.en:
???
「It took life born in the sea hundreds of millions of years to reach land... Then, through cycles of rise and fall, countless more years to take human form.」

598:t_2:18.en:
???
「That is what evolution is. It cannot be experienced within an individual's allotted lifespan.」

598:t_2:20.en:
???
「...But being a $$ニュータイプ$$ means an expansion of perception. It is said to bring about a change in an individual's consciousness...」

598:t_2:21.en:
???
「Those who believed in that infinite potential created it on the last night of the Anno Domini era... at the very moment the $$宇宙世紀$$ began.」

598:t_2:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The moment the $$宇宙世紀$$ began...?」

598:t_2:23.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The terrorist attack on $$ラプラス$$, the $$地球連邦$$ prime minister's residence in space... Commonly called the $$ラプラス事件$$...」

598:t_2:24.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That day, the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter was to announce the direction of a new era... but someone blew up $$ラプラス$$...」

598:t_2:25.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Many representatives of Federation member nations died, including its first prime minister, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, fueling calls to suppress antigovernment movements...」

598:t_2:26.en:
???
「One might call it the beginning of the $$宇宙世紀$$'s bloodstained history.」

598:t_2:27.en:
???
「Yet what should have been born there was a prayer for a new era.」

598:t_2:29.en:
???
「I will show it to you. Go on.」

598:t_2:31.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go, $$オードリー$$... so we can see everything with our own eyes.」

598:t_3:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Was our world destined to fight...?」

598:t_3:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not true, $$オードリー$$.」

598:t_3:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We have fought, yes. But we did it to open a path to the future.」

598:t_3:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ガンダム$$ guides me... I understand that when I pilot the $$ユニコーン$$.」

598:t_3:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's why we have to move forward through this battle.」

598:t_3:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've seen it in textbooks... It's the stone monument... of the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter...」

598:t_3:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But it's different from the one we know...! There's an extra article!」

598:t_3:19.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Should the emergence of a new human species adapted to space be recognized in the future, those people shall be given priority in participating in government...」

598:t_3:20.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying this article... was deleted from the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter...?」

598:t_3:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Does that mean $$ニュータイプ$$s...?」

598:t_3:25.en:
$$サイアム$$
「It is the true nature of the curse... that has bound us for so long. And... it is a prayer as well...」

598:t_4:5.en:
$$ガエル$$
「This is $$サイアム・ビスト$$. The founder of the $$ビスト財団$$, and, $$バナージ$$... your great-grandfather.」

598:t_4:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Were you watching from here...? You saw all the fighting over the Box, and you...!」

598:t_4:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... For many years, you used $$ラプラスの箱$$... this true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter... to extract favors from the Federation.」

598:t_4:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why do you now intend to give it up of your own accord?」

598:t_4:11.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Because the time has come... Now, humanity will advance to a new stage...」

598:t_4:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Beyond... the civilization of fire...」

598:t_4:13.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Without despair, without stagnation... A prayer to face the god called possibility once more... If we let this moment pass...」
